description: Retired 2026-11-05 from ora/policy/context_schemes; kept as a test fixture of the stages and management versions that remain. context_rolling_tail_v2's policy plus exchange aging (management v9's stages), with camera images under the same window instead of a camera tail: an observation's camera images stay inline in the message where it arrived (camera_images exchange_window_v1). At 100,000 provider input tokens (at most half the hard limit) every exchange older than the latest 6 keeps a short reference instead of its long tool-call arguments, long tool results, tool-returned and camera images and older observation bodies (readable with artifact_read or observe(ref=...)), again for every further 6 exchanges while the request stays at or above it; a hard backstop keeps every request under the hard limit. Its own prompt (rolling-tail-v3.md).
